description: Two-panel collage (made with Mematic). Top: photo of a TV showing Fox News live coverage of Rep. Alcee Hastings (D-FL) at a House Rules Committee hearing setting guidelines for the impeachment debate, with 'House Impeachment Vote' special-coverage graphics (December 2019). Bottom: a Wikipedia-style text excerpt recounting Hastings' 1988 impeachment by the House for bribery and perjury (413-3) and his October 20 1989 Senate conviction, making him the sixth federal judge removed from office. The pairing implies irony that an impeached ex-judge helped run the Trump impeachment process.
text: CAPITOL HILL. 3:14 PM ET. FOX NEWS. ALCEE HASTINGS (D-FL) | HOUSE RULES COMMITTEE. HOUSE RULES PANEL HOLDS HEARING TO SET GUIDELINES FOR IMPEACHMENT DEBATE. HOUSE IMPEACHMENT VOTE. SPECIAL COVERAGE. ALL DAY TOMORROW. In 1988, the Democratic-controlled United States House of Representatives took up the case, and Hastings was impeached for bribery and perjury by a vote of 413-3. He was then convicted on October 20, 1989, by the United States Senate, becoming the sixth federal judge in the history of the United States to be removed from office by the Senate.
